node_8.subject: Giorgio Rossi
node_8.description: This is Giorgio Rossi's plan for Monday February 13: wake up and complete the morning routine at 7:00 am, wake up and complete the morning routine at 7:00 am, review mathematical concepts for today's class from 7:30 am to 8:00 am, attend high school classes from 8:30 am to 2:30 pm, work on the research project on mathematical patterns in nature from 3:00 pm to 3:45 pm, eat dinner at 4:00 pm, analyze potential candidates for the class minister election from 5:00 pm to 5:30 pm, solve advanced math problems for self-study from 6:00 pm to 7:30 pm, read about fractal patterns in nature from 8:00 pm to 9:00 pm, wind down with light browsing on mathematical forums from 10:00 pm to 11:30 pm, go to bed at midnight.
